title: An Act to Correct Inconsistencies, Conflicts and Errors in the Laws of Maine (EMERGENCY)

summary.text:
Part A does the following.

Section 1 removes an obsolete cross-reference and makes a technical correction. Section 2 makes a technical correction.

Section 3 corrects a cross-reference.

Section 4 corrects a cross-reference and makes a technical correction.

Section 45 corrects a conflict created by Public Law 2025, chapters 385 and 388, which affected the same provision of law, by repealing the provision and replacing it with the chapter 388 version.

Section 46 corrects a conflict created by Public Law 2025, chapters 385 and 388, which affected the same provision of law, by incorporating the changes made by both laws. Section 47 corrects a cross-reference.

Section 48 makes a technical correction and a grammatical change.

Section 49 corrects a cross-reference.

Section 53 corrects a conflict created by Public Law 2025, chapters 367 and 388, which affected the same provision of law, by repealing the provision.

Section 54 removes an obsolete cross-reference.

Section 55 removes an obsolete cross-reference.

Section 56 modifies a provision to reflect the intent of the revision clause in Public Law 2025, chapter 316, section 3 by replacing a phrase that was based on the term "physician assistant." Section 57 corrects a clerical error.
